description: This file defines the 'ReaderScreen' widget for a Flutter app, which displays book content and provides controls for font size, theme, and navigating chapters. It manages state through providers and interacts with UI components like AppBar, BookmarkButton, and ReaderControls.

classes.name: ReaderScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget that renders the book chapter content, manages user interactions, and provides controls for font size, theme, and chapter navigation.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the ReaderScreen widget.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Initializes the widget by extracting arguments from the route and opening the specified book.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the reader screen, including the app bar, content display, and controls.
